newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Air says traffic up 14.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Air says traffic up 14.5 percent.

text.p: Alaska Air Group Inc said third quarter passenger traffic rose 14.5 percent on a capacity increase of 7.0 percent.

Passenger load factor climbed 4.6 points to 70.6 percent, compared with 66.0 percent in 1995. The airline's yield per revenue passenger mile (RPM) decreased 0.8 percent. Operating cost per available seat mile (ASM) increased 5.8 percent, primarily due to higher fuel prices, the federal fuel tax and employee profit sharing. Alaska's pretax income increased to $52.9 million compared with $49.1 million a year earlier.
